One thing I did not expect when I started my consulting business was how much time would disappear just trying to find the right businesses and people to contact.

Searching online.

Checking websites.

Looking for emails and phone numbers.

Building lists manually before the real work could even start.

That experience is one of the reasons I built ALPA.

The goal was simple:

Reduce hours of searching into seconds and make it easier to find businesses to contact with website, email, and phone included.

If you run a service business and recognize that frustration, you can take a look here:

https://alpa.mindrasolutions.com
